legacy_root.method: Structured Python AST (os.environ.get/getenv/os.environ[], settings.get/cfg.get, argparse dest) plus PowerShell Get-ItemProperty/$env: and YAML ${ENV}. Signal 2 is a whole-tree token scan of read-shaped lines and distinctive quoted identifiers in product Python (the catalog pivot when a grep misses non-Python or dynamic defaults.get(field) consumers). Live product scans skip command-center/p2-wave/probes/ so sibling fixtures are not shipped config. This unit's own probe tree is excluded from live reads (use-vs-mention).
legacy_root.notes: G-1 for BLD-0005. Live named probes re-run exit 0. Artifact is not self-declared BLOCKED. Per-unit UNIT-ARTIFACT-MANIFEST.json is written beside the probes (not tools/command-center/unit_manifest.py --write). cloud ok=true is not delivery. This worktree has no shipped plugin.json / marketplace / settings schema / workflow presets / .coverage-thresholds.json outside probe fixtures; live declared keys are the catalog defaults block plus any of those files that appear.
